note: Sound effects the edit can place with sfx(t, kind). scripts/sfx.py generates only the kinds the edit uses (timing/points.json) and trims each file's leading silence. family sets its loudness in the mix: impact +3 LU, tonal -4 LU and low-passed, other 0, around mix.sfx_lufs. alias maps a shrill kind to a soft one (the director of the Shepherdr infomercial, 21 Oct 2026: no loud beeps).

whoosh: fast cartoon whoosh swipe, punchy, comedic
notification: a single bright phone notification ping
stamp: a heavy rubber stamp slammed onto paper on a desk, one hit
zoom-punch: a cinematic zoom punch impact, a short whoosh into a deep thump
window-pop: a computer window popping open, a short bubbly UI pop
implosion: a cartoon black hole implosion: a sucking reverse whoosh collapsing into a deep thud
record-scratch: a vinyl record scratch that stops the music, comedic
choir-swell: an epic heavenly choir swell rising, 'aaah', majestic and over the top
riser: a cinematic synth riser building tension, sweeping up
ding: a bright bell ding, correct answer
drumroll: a snare drum roll building up, then a cymbal crash
coin: a retro 8-bit video game coin pickup sound, soft and warm
game-show-sting: a cheesy TV game show sting, brass and synth, short and triumphant
squeak: a rubber duck squeak, single squeeze
tape-stop: a tape stop effect, audio slowing down and pitching down to a halt
reverb-boom: a massive cinematic boom with a long echoing reverb tail, like a voice in a cathedral
smooth-jazz-sting: a short smooth jazz saxophone lick, cheesy infomercial testimonial
goat-bleat: a single goat bleat, close, a little silly
hit: a big orchestral hit with timpani, 'dun!', dramatic infomercial reveal
blender: a kitchen blender running at maximum speed, roaring motor and ice, comedic
roar: a tiger roar, short and powerful
splash: a big liquid splash into a container
sad-trombone: a sad trombone 'wah wah wah waaah', comedic failure
rocket: rocket thrusters igniting with a hiss of cold gas and a whoosh past the camera
cash-register: an old mechanical cash register cha-ching
phone-ring: a bank of old telephones ringing at once in an infomercial call center
typing: fast typing on a mechanical keyboard, a short burst
sparkle: a magical sparkle shimmer chime, twinkling
explosion: a huge cinematic explosion, deep boom with debris, over the top
explosion-small: a short punchy cartoon explosion pop
fire-whoosh: a big burst of fire igniting, a roaring flame whoosh
crowd-cheer: a studio audience cheering and applauding wildly, infomercial
price-slam: a heavy metallic slam with a cash register bell, comedic price reveal
brass-hits: three short punchy brass section hits, 'bap bap baaa', warm and hype, mellow, not shrill
alarm-soft: a comedic cartoon alarm, two soft wobbly low 'woop woop' pulses, muffled and mellow, not piercing
laser-soft: two soft retro sci-fi 'pew pew' blips, low-pitched, round and mellow, short
buzzer-soft: a soft low comedic tuba 'bwomp' wrong-answer sound
swoop-soft: a comedic rising 'bwooop' swoop on a soft round synth, playful, mellow, not a whistle
chiptune-soft: a short 8-bit victory fanfare played with soft triangle waves, warm and mellow, not piercing
mic-drop: a microphone dropped onto a stage floor through a PA system: a loud thud, then a short low feedback hum that cuts off
window-shut: an old wooden window slammed shut, glass rattling
soft-whoosh: a soft airy whoosh, gentle UI transition
soft-pop: a soft round UI pop, quiet and friendly
